title: Christianity: Overview — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Christianity centers on Jesus of Nazareth, whom Christians believe to be the Son of God and savior, and it is the world's largest religion. The Pew Research Center estimated about 2.2 billion Christians worldwide as of 2010, roughly 31 percent of humanity. This overview edition presents Christianity: Overview within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
